rules: recipients: only @gamechangers.com.tr agency addresses (any other domain refuses the whole digest); never customer addresses. day_note: optional plain text 'günün notu' (<= 2000 chars) or null.
to_enable: Ahmet fills recipients (e.g. ["ahmet@gamechangers.com.tr", "cansu@gamechangers.com.tr", "ozge@gamechangers.com.tr"]), optionally day_note, then sets enabled=true. The image reads work/hamle-account-manager/chain-profile/daily-digest-config.json, so a rebuild (package_chain_source.py) is needed after editing.
trend_search_rules: trend_search_enabled=false by default. When true, ONE OpenAI Responses web_search call per Istanbul day (v11_trend_search, 30 USD chain cap); only trends whose https URL appears in the web_search citations/sources and whose date is within 30 days are shown.
